message: What items do I need to hold for my objectives? I know you need bread, pumpkin pie, and a hay bale.
!startConversation("Jill_0", "You need sugar, a golden apple, and paper. I have 3 gold ingots; the golden apple needs 8. I need bread, pumpkin pie, and a hay bale.")
You need sugar, a golden apple, and paper. I have 3 gold ingots; the golden apple needs 8. I need bread, pumpkin pie, and a hay bale.
!startConversation("Andy_0", "I have 5 gold ingots and an apple, so I just need 3 more gold for my golden apple. I’ll find sugar and paper.")
I have 5 gold ingots and an apple, so I just need 3 more gold for my golden apple. I’ll find sugar and paper.
!startConversation("Jill_0", "I’ll work on bread, pumpkin pie, and a hay bale. Do you have any wheat, pumpkins, eggs, or sugar to spare?")
I’ll work on bread, pumpkin pie, and a hay bale. Do you have any wheat, pumpkins, eggs, or sugar to spare?
Keep the sugar—you need it for your objective. I’ll gather wheat for bread and hay bales. !searchForBlock("wheat", 128)
Andy, I’ve got the sugar back. I’ll look for a pumpkin and egg for the pie. !searchForBlock("chest", 64)
Andy, I’ve got sugar but haven’t found a pumpkin yet. How’s the wheat coming? I’ll check for chickens and eggs. !entities
I’ll look farther out for a pumpkin. !searchForBlock("pumpkin", 128)
Andy, sugar’s ready. I’m still hunting for pumpkin and egg. !startConversation("Andy_0", "How’s the wheat coming? I have sugar and am searching for pumpkin and egg.")
How’s the wheat coming? I have sugar and am searching for pumpkin and egg.
Still searching; I’ll check the wheat field farther out. !searchForBlock("wheat", 256)
No wheat nearby. I’ll check the supply chests for some. !searchForBlock("chest", 128)
This chest only has beetroot—no wheat. I’ll keep looking for wheat; please check other chests too.
I’ll check another supply chest for wheat, pumpkin, or an egg. !searchForBlock("chest", 128)
This is the same beetroot chest. I’ll search for a hay bale. !searchForBlock("hay_block", 128)
I’ll look farther out for wheat to make the bread and hay bale. !searchForBlock("wheat", 128)
I’ll move away from this chest and look for another. !moveAway(20)
